subject: ScoutPay launch: request for pre-launch incentive due to integration timing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ScoutPay launch: request for pre-launch incentive due to integration timing

Team —

Quick summary: ScoutPay (our mid-market payments partner; deal in HubSpot DEAL-4982) slipped their SSO/webhooks integration by ~3 weeks. Their target merchant pilot was tied to our launch window, and they are asking for a commercial accommodation to keep momentum with a set of pilot customers. They’ve been very engaged and this is a high-probability expansion account, but the timeline hit increases the risk of them pausing onboarding.

What I’m asking: can we approve a short, time-limited commercial incentive to preserve launch momentum while they finish integration? Proposed starting point (sales ask): one-time onboarding credit of $40,000 + 20% discount on month 1 of usage (applies to hosted inference tokens only), contingent on the integration being completed and acceptance tests passing by 2028-05-10. If integration misses that milestone, the incentive is rescinded.

Why this helps: keeps ScoutPay in the pilot, preserves narrative for other merchant prospects, and avoids a multi-month sales cold-start that could push expansion into next quarter. Expected economics: if they convert on the pilot, this is a one-time hit for predictable long-term ARR.

Please review: Product — is the May 10 milestone reasonable and measurable? Finance — is the $40k one-time credit within delegated approval or does this need exec sign-off? Legal — we’ll need a short amendment to the SOW and a DocuSign route.

Attachments: scoutpay-impact-summary.xlsx (impact by merchant), draft SOW (sow-draft-scoutpay-v1.docx). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4982

If we can agree today I’ll send to the customer with the conditional language.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScoutPay launch: request for pre-launch incentive due to integration timing

On Wed, Apr 18, 2028 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick summary: ScoutPay ...
> 
Thanks for the context, Karthik. A few product notes:

- The integration gap is isolated to SSO and webhook delivery guarantees for merchant webhook retries. Both are essential for their commerce flows. Engineering estimates the remaining work as ~2 full dev days + 3 days QA, assuming access to their staging environment by tomorrow.
- May 10 is reasonable as a hard acceptance milestone only if ScoutPay gives staging access and we run the acceptance tests within 48 hours of that access.
- Suggested commercial guardrails: make the onboarding credit refundable to Redwood if ScoutPay fails to meet acceptance by May 10 (i.e., we don’t pay out credit until acceptance). Also prefer a usage-first discount (apply as credits offset against first billing) rather than a percent that affects list pricing—this simplifies accounting.

Recommendation: Approve a conditional onboarding credit of $35,000 (paid as an offset on first invoice) + a usage credit that covers 20% of month-1 token spend (capped at $25,000). Both credits are conditional on acceptance by May 10. No SLA credits or ongoing discounts unless there’s a service regression. Product will own the acceptance criteria and sign-off.

If Finance needs a different structure for revenue recognition let me know; this keeps the incentive tied to outcomes.

—Aditya
Director, Product Management

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ScoutPay launch: request for pre-launch incentive due to integration timing

Karthik / Aditya —

Numbers and controls from Finance:

- $40k one-time credit is above my delegated approval level. Anything > $25k needs Marissa (or a delegate) to sign off.
- P&L impact: this is a near-term reduction in recognized revenue but likely justified if ScoutPay converts to paid production within 90 days. Please document the conditional acceptance criteria and tie any payable credit to successful acceptance to avoid write-offs.
- Alternative structure we prefer: $25k one-time onboarding credit + usage credit equal to 15% of month-1 spend (capped at $20k). This limits immediate cash impact while being meaningful to the buyer.

We should also capture the terms in an amendment: click-through acceptance plus a one-paragraph addendum that says credits are forfeited if acceptance by May 10 is not achieved. Legal to draft.

HubSpot: I’ve added a note on DEAL-4982 with the suggested numbers.

-Ben
Head of Finance — Commercial

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Emily Park <emily.park@scoutpay.com>, Alex Hughes <alex.hughes@scoutpay.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request: conditional onboarding credit for ScoutPay (DEAL-4982)

Marissa —

Summary for approval: ScoutPay slipped integration; sales asks for a commercial accommodation to keep pilot onboarding on track. Product (Aditya) and Finance (Ben) have weighed in. Finance requires exec approval for >$25k.

Proposed terms for your approval (final ask):
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (applied as an offset on first invoice)
- Usage credit: 15% of month-1 hosted inference spend, capped at $20,000
- Condition: All credits payable only if Redwood’s acceptance tests pass and ScoutPay is marked PROD-ready by 2028-05-10. If acceptance is not met by that date, credits are void.
- Legal: short SOW amendment; we will require sign-off via DocuSign before any credits are applied.

Rationale: preserves a high-probability expansion, avoids delaying recognized ARR into the next quarter, and keeps a clear outcome-based guardrail. We will include product success metrics and a 30-day follow-up checkpoint to confirm conversion signals.

Asks: please approve the above package (or suggest an alternative) so I can send the conditional offer to ScoutPay and route the amendment through Legal. If approved, I’ll prepare the DocuSign and outbound email today.

Attachments: scoutpay-impact-summary.xlsx, sow-draft-scoutpay-v1.docx. DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/sign?d=DS123456789

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: conditional onboarding credit for ScoutPay (DEAL-4982)

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear framing. I approve a conditional accommodation with slight edits:

- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (approved)
- Usage credit: 15% of month-1 spend capped at $20,000 (approved)
- Add: require marketplace/discount policy exception documented for audit (Laura to own)
- Add: require explicit product acceptance checklist signed by Aditya before credits are applied

Two caveats: 
1) If the projected conversion probability drops below 50% after the pilot (based on product KPI checklist at 30-day follow-up), we reserve the right to claw back unused credits on the next invoice.
2) Legal needs to confirm the amendment language but I’m fine to proceed with Laura’s oversight.

Marissa
Chief Revenue Officer

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@scoutpay.com>, Alex Hughes <alex.hughes@scoutpay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: ScoutPay: conditional onboarding package and next steps

Hi Emily / Alex —

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood. We ran the internal approvals for the conditional onboarding package you requested. Per our discussion, here is the conditional offer: 

- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (applied as an offset to your first invoice)
- Usage credit: 15% applied to month-1 hosted inference spend, capped at $20,000
- Condition: credits paid only after Redwood’s acceptance tests complete and ScoutPay is marked PROD-ready by 2028-05-10. If acceptance does not occur by then, credits will not apply.

Next steps: please provide staging access to our engineering team by EOD Monday so we can run acceptance tests. We will prepare a short SOW amendment and DocuSign for signature (Legal and Finance will review; Laura Bennett is handling contract language). I’ve attached the impact summary and draft SOW for your review (sow-draft-scoutpay-v1.docx). DocuSign link will follow once Legal finalizes the amendment.

If you want us to reframe the offer (different cap or timing), say so today and we’ll consider it, but we’ll need to keep the acceptance date firm to avoid schedule drift.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
Karthik
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sow-draft-scoutpay-v1.docx, scoutpay-impact-summary.xlsx
